HandTop %1$s
Desktop in your hand.

A desktop for Android: windows, a taskbar and a terminal. Linux apps are coming next.

Current stage: 1 — desktop shell and Android terminal.

License: GNU GPL v3.
The terminal emulator is based on Termux (Apache 2.0).

Shortcuts:
Ctrl+Alt+T — new terminal
Alt+F4 — close window
Ctrl+Shift+C / V — copy / paste
Ctrl+Plus / Ctrl+Minus — font size
